$comment: Allowlist for validate-nav.ts. Every entry needs a reason string. Entries here are either deliberately hidden pages or pre-existing violations grandfathered when the guardrail was introduced (tracked in ethereum-optimism/solutions#955); the grandfathered set only shrinks — new violations always fail CI.
